test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error.'**

None of them, apart from Rohan / and Shilpa, had heard Mohan talk / about what happens that night.

options.text: and Shilpa, had heard Mohan talk
None of them, apart from Rohan

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"about what happens that night."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"what happens that night."**
 
• The given sentence talks about past events so we have to maintain the past tense in the sentence.
 
• "Happens" is in the present tense.
 
• The past tense form of **"happen"** is **"happened."**
 
• So, we need to replace **"happens"** with **"happened."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *None of them, apart from Rohan and Shilpa, had heard Mohan talk **about what happened that night**__.*
